regions.full_page: Thanks be to God I am sure we all enjoyed our little "day off" to St. Bonaventures and to our Lady of Prompt Succor, etc. We arrived back at St. Felix at 6:05 p.m. Deo Gratias. However, we would hardly be Capuchins if some one of the crowd did not forget something. Possibly you found the trousers I left in the corner room, where you found the hat yesterday a.m. I hope you have them on their way hither, if not I would ap- preciate your sending them on as soon as convenient. Before I thought of it, we were well on our way to St. Felix.
